reuse.why: expectedAmount is computed with the existing shared getScheduledAmount, the same function that posting, preview, forecast and templates use.

duplication.why: No amount logic is duplicated; the handler only spreads toExternal and adds one call.

placement.why: The field is added in the api/schedules-get handler with a dedicated APIScheduleListEntity type; putting it in scheduleModel.toExternal would be equally reasonable, but keeping the create/update input type clean is a sound choice.

scope.why: Only the list handler, its return type, a test and a release note change.

maintainability.why: Any future change to the expected-amount rule in getScheduledAmount flows to the API automatically.
